values.note: CampLife one-night estimates for 2 adults, before the 10% tax, every date read (Oct 2026, Jan 2027, Jun 2027, weekday and Saturday alike): full-hookup RV sites $60-75 including the park's $3 reservation fee, so $57 (30-amp back-ins and pull-throughs, 30-45 ft) to $72 (50-amp oversized pull-throughs and premium waterfront back-ins) a night; primitive tent sites $35. Two-night estimates confirm the $3 is once per stay. Electric, water, sewer and limited Wi-Fi included. A $20 Site Lock fee guarantees a specific site.

values.note: CampLife sells 43 RV sites (27 pull-through, 15 back-in, 1 pull-in; 30-45 ft long, 16 ft wide) and 10 tent sites. 'Waterfront' sites overlook the spring-fed pond (Reel Calm Pond); the river is a 1,500-ft boardwalk walk away.

values.note: Wi-Fi is 'limited'. The General Store is mostly self-service and cashless; firewood must be bought there.

facilities.source: https://www.thehideawayfl.com/camp-amenities ('Bath House & Coin Laundry', 'General Store') + https://www.thehideawayfl.com/campfaqs ('limited WiFi', 'Our General Store ... operates primarily as a self-service, cashless store'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked online on CampLife ('BOOK NOW'). Without the $20 Site Lock the assigned site may change. Monthly stays only in designated areas, generally up to six months. Check-in noon-5 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Cancellation: $25 fee 8+ days out, 50% refund 3-7 days, none within 3 days.

note: Old-Florida campground near the Suwannee River at Old Town, on a 100-acre property with primitive tent sites, glamping planned from December 2026, pool and clubhouse. A 1,500-ft boardwalk runs through wetlands to the river and a riverside trail. --Claude
summary: Priced from CampLife (all dates Oct 2026-Jun 2027): $57-72/night RV full hookup plus a $3 per-stay fee, before 10% tax. Confirmed 50-amp full hookups, camp store, online booking; added 53 sites (43 RV, 30-45 ft, 27 pull-through), showers/laundry/limited Wi-Fi, booking terms. Note: dropped hookups/store/booking text and 'annual rates' (FAQ: monthly stays generally limited to six months, not permanent residency).
flags: Over the US$50 private price gate: cheapest RV site $57/night before tax (CampLife estimate $60 incl. $3 per-stay fee, every date read). Nearest gateway Jacksonville, 153 km (St. Augustine 164 km); not within 40 km of one. The family has not stayed here (no trip references).

Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator advertises 'peaceful waterfront spots' / 'Waterfront Sites', and CampLife tags sites 60, 65 and 66 'Water-front' with 'a beautiful overlook of the pond' (the spring-fed Reel Calm Pond); entry is 'not waterfront'. The Suwannee is a 1,500-ft boardwalk walk away, not at the sites.
